title: Ziggy's Compressed Blocks
description: A light Minecraft mod that adds various compressed blocks for convenience and block variety
body:
![(left) A full chest of rotten flesh. (right) a chest containing six stacks of compressed rotten flesh blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8e4f3b22e0edff85cff8ac7a1c859cacfbfed48.png)

A light Minecraft mod that adds various compressed blocks for convenience and block variety. 
The goal of this mod isn't to compress every block, or recursive compressions, as these mods exist already (checkout CB: Compressed Blocks for a cool example). The goal if these mod is to target the obvious cases in a polished way (e.g. compressed blaze rod blocks emit light). 

This mod is perfect for running your items from a farm into a crafter before heading to storage.

Blocks added:
* Compressed Dirt
* Compressed Cobblestone
* Compressed Stone
* Compressed Sand
* Compressed Grass Block
* Compressed Netherrack
* Compressed End Stone
* Compressed Obsidian
* Compressed Cobbbled Deepslate
* Compressed Deepslate
* Compressed Blackstone 
* Compressed Basalt
* Compressed Carrot
* Compressed Potato
* Compressed Beetroot
* Compressed Sugar Cane
* Compressed Melon
* Compressed Pumpkin
* Compressed Cactus
* Compressed Feather
* Compressed Egg
* Compressed Leather
* Compressed Arrow
* Compressed Spider Eye
* Compressed Gunpowder

A disclaimer on the art:
I am not an experienced pixel artist and have used placeholder generated art for the mean time. If you have suggestions or would like to add your own art, let me know!
